description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets originating from different researcher locations over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, while the vertical axis represents “Number of datasets,” labeled with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10². Each year contains a grouped set of bars representing datasets from “Other” (blue), “USA” (orange), “IN” (green), “UK” (red), “IT” (purple), and “DE” (brown) researchers. In 2012, the “USA” bar is approximately 2, while the “Other” bar is approximately 0.5. In 2022, the “UK” bar reaches approximately 80, the tallest bar in the chart, while the “DE” bar is approximately 2. The bars are grouped by year, with each color representing a different researcher location. The chart does not appear to be sorted by any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
